2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)]

MINISTRY OF LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT

NOTIFICATION

New Delhi, the 21st November, 2025

S.O. 5320(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (3) of section 1 of the
Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (35 of 2020), the Central Government hereby appoints the
21st day of November, 2025 as the date on which the provisions of the said Code, shall come into
force.

[F.No. S-11025/07/2025-IR(PL)]
DEEPIKA KACHHAL, Jt. Secy.
